import subprocess,json,hashlib,base64
R='repos/Melihakbulut221/nssoc/'
B='codex/complete-open-work'
def api(path,data=None,method=None):
 c=['gh','api',R+path]
 if data is not None:c+=['--method',method or 'POST','--input','-']
 r=subprocess.run(c,input=json.dumps(data)if data is not None else None,text=True,capture_output=True)
 if r.returncode:raise RuntimeError('GitHub API '+path+': '+r.stderr[:2000])
 return json.loads(r.stdout)if r.stdout.strip()else {}
def remote(path,ref):
 d=api('contents/'+path+'?ref='+ref)
 if d.get('content'):return base64.b64decode(d['content'])
 return base64.b64decode(api('git/blobs/'+d['sha'])['content'])
def asset(aid):
 return subprocess.check_output(['gh','api',R+'releases/assets/'+str(aid),'-H','Accept: application/octet-stream'])
def sha(b):return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def publish(head,files,msg):
 parent=api('git/commits/'+head)
 entries=[]
 for p,d in files.items():
  if isinstance(d,str):d=d.encode()
  blob=api('git/blobs',{'encoding':'base64','content':base64.b64encode(d).decode()})
  entries.append({'path':p,'mode':'100644','type':'blob','sha':blob['sha']})
 tree=api('git/trees',{'base_tree':parent['tree']['sha'],'tree':entries})
 commit=api('git/commits',{'message':msg,'tree':tree['sha'],'parents':[head]})
 assert api('git/ref/heads/'+B)['object']['sha']==head
 api('git/refs/heads/'+B,{'sha':commit['sha'],'force':False},'PATCH')
 return commit['sha']

import time
_api_once=api
def api(path,data=None,method=None):
 for attempt in range(4):
  try:return _api_once(path,data,method)
  except RuntimeError as exc:
   transient=any(x in str(exc) for x in ('TLS handshake timeout','connection reset','unexpected EOF','HTTP 502','HTTP 503','HTTP 504','i/o timeout'))
   if data is not None or method not in (None,'GET') or not transient or attempt==3:raise
   time.sleep(2+attempt)

# Cloud API/derived-text collector. Never fetch a native capsule or native artifact.
import zlib
from pathlib import PurePosixPath
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
RUN=41118688730
SOURCE="fa863489c783be96d567f5309891e013532378c4"
RELEASE=429431405
TAG="cloud-results-41118688730-1-mainchip-multilayer-antenna-trial"

files={};errors=[];decoded={};rawlogs={};pins={}
def keep(name,b):
 assert isinstance(b,bytes)
 p=PurePosixPath(name)
 assert name and not p.is_absolute() and ".."not in p.parts and "\\"not in name
 dest=PREFIX+name
 assert dest not in files
 files[dest]=b
 pins[name]=dict(bytes=len(b),sha256=sha(b))
 return b
def raw_api(path):
 # The only octet-stream requests below are two explicitly named derived JSON assets.
 r=subprocess.run(["gh","api",R+path],capture_output=True)
 if r.returncode:raise RuntimeError(r.stderr.decode()[:2000])
 return r.stdout
def document(path,name):
 b=raw_api(path);keep(name,b);return json.loads(b)
def guarded(label,fn):
 try:return fn()
 except Exception as exc:errors.append(dict(stage=label,type=type(exc).__name__,error=str(exc)))
run=document("actions/runs/"+str(RUN),"run.json")
assert run["id"]==RUN and run["head_sha"]==SOURCE and run["run_attempt"]==1 and run["workflow_id"]==401215446
assert run["status"]=="completed","Read-only guard: run is still live; no publication attempted"
jobs=document("actions/runs/"+str(RUN)+"/attempts/1/jobs?per_page=100","jobs.json")["jobs"]
assert len(jobs)==4 and {j["name"]for j in jobs}=={"source-controls","preserve-job-log","trial","preserve-antenna-job-logs"}
for listed in jobs:
 j=document("actions/jobs/"+str(listed["id"]),"jobs/"+str(listed["id"])+".json")
 assert j["head_sha"]==SOURCE and j["run_id"]==RUN and j["status"]=="completed" and j["name"]==listed["name"]
 if j["conclusion"]=="skipped":continue
 b=raw_api("actions/jobs/"+str(j["id"])+"/logs");assert b
 keep("logs/"+str(j["id"])+".log",b);rawlogs[j["name"]]=b
def safe_derived(name):
 p=PurePosixPath(name)
 assert not p.is_absolute() and ".."not in p.parts and "\\"not in name and name
 assert p.suffix in(".json",".jsonl",".stdout",".stderr",".rpt")or(".json."in p.name and p.suffix==".tmp")
 return name
def controls():
 indexes={};chunks={}
 for line in rawlogs["source-controls"].decode().splitlines():
  for marker,index in (("NET459_DIODE_PRUNE_CONTROL_INDEX ",True),("NET459_DIODE_PRUNE_CONTROL_CHUNK ",False)):
   if marker not in line:continue
   v=line.split(marker,1)[1]
   if not v.startswith("{"):continue
   d=json.loads(v);name=safe_derived(d["path"]);assert "/"not in name
   if index:assert name not in indexes;indexes[name]=d
   else:
    part=chunks.setdefault(name,{});assert d["index"]not in part;part[d["index"]]=d
 expected=["context.json"]
 for name in("controls","antenna-controls","ownership-controls","trial-controls","window-controls","multilayer-controls"):
  expected += [name+".json",name+".stdout",name+".stderr"]
 assert set(indexes)==set(expected)
 for name,d in indexes.items():
  assert d["present"]is True
  rows=chunks.get(name,{})
  assert set(rows)==set(range(d["chunks"]))
  b=b"".join(base64.b64decode(rows[i]["base64"],validate=True)for i in range(d["chunks"]))
  assert len(b)==d["bytes"]and sha(b)==d["sha256"]
  keep("source-records/"+name,b)
  if name.endswith(".json"):decoded["source/"+name]=json.loads(b)
 c=decoded["source/context.json"];assert c["source"]==SOURCE and c["run"]==RUN and c["attempt"]==1
 r=decoded["source/multilayer-controls.json"]
 assert r["status"]=="PASS_MULTILAYER_ANTENNA_TRIAL_SOURCE_CONTROLS"and(r["positive_count"],r["refusal_count"],r["lifecycle_count"])==(13,68,4)
 o=r['def_import_order_controls']
 assert o['status']=='PASS_STRICT_TARGET_ITERM_ORDER_SOURCE_CONTROLS' and(o['positive_count'],o['refusal_count'])==(3,22)and o['full_native_DEF_replayed']is False
 return dict(full_records=19,positive=13,refusal=68,lifecycle=4,order_positive=3,order_refusal=22)
source_controls=guarded("full-source-controls",controls)
def native_records():
 indexes=[];chunks={}
 for line in rawlogs["trial"].decode().splitlines():
  if "MULTILAYER_ANTENNA_TRIAL_INDEX "in line:
   v=line.split("MULTILAYER_ANTENNA_TRIAL_INDEX ",1)[1]
   if v.startswith("{"):indexes.append(json.loads(v))
  if "MULTILAYER_ANTENNA_TRIAL_CHUNK "in line:
   v=line.split("MULTILAYER_ANTENNA_TRIAL_CHUNK ",1)[1]
   if not v.startswith("{"):continue
   d=json.loads(v);name=safe_derived(d["name"])
   part=chunks.setdefault(name,{})
   assert type(d["index"])is int and d["index"]not in part;part[d["index"]]=d
 assert len(indexes)==1
 index=indexes[0];assert set(chunks)==set(index)
 keep("native-record-index.json",(json.dumps(index,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+"\n").encode())
 for name,pin in index.items():
  safe_derived(name);assert type(pin["bytes"])is int and 0<=pin["bytes"]<=2*1024**2
  rows=chunks[name];count=rows[0]["chunks"]
  assert set(rows)==set(range(count))
  pieces=[]
  for i in range(count):
   d=rows[i]
   assert d["chunks"]==count and d["bytes"]==pin["bytes"]and d["sha256"]==pin["sha256"]and d["encoding"]=="zlib-base64"
   pieces.append(base64.b64decode(d["base64"],validate=True))
  z=zlib.decompressobj();b=z.decompress(b"".join(pieces),pin["bytes"]+1)
  assert z.eof and not z.unused_data and not z.unconsumed_tail and len(b)==pin["bytes"]and sha(b)==pin["sha256"]
  keep("native-records/"+name,b)
  if name.endswith(".json"):decoded[name]=json.loads(b)
 return dict(full_records=len(index),complete=True)
native=guarded("full-derived-native-records",native_records)
info=document("releases/"+str(RELEASE),"release.json")
ref=document("git/ref/tags/"+TAG,"release-ref.json")
assert info["id"]==RELEASE and info["tag_name"]==TAG and info["target_commitish"]==SOURCE
assert info["draft"]is False and info["prerelease"]is True
assert ref["object"]["type"]=="commit"and ref["object"]["sha"]==SOURCE
assets={x["name"]:x for x in info["assets"]}
assert len(assets)==len(info["assets"])
def capsule_join():
 pub=decoded["native-capsule-publication.json"]
 assert pub["status"]=="COMPLETE_PERMANENT_NATIVE_CAPSULE"and pub["source"]==SOURCE and pub["release_id"]==RELEASE and pub["tag"]==TAG
 assert pub["native_bytes_remain_in_cloud"]is True and pub["partial_failure_preserved"]is True
 assert {a["name"]for a in pub["assets"]}==set(assets)
 for expected in pub["assets"]:
  a=assets[expected["name"]]
  assert a["id"]==expected["id"]and a["size"]==expected["bytes"]and a["digest"]=="sha256:"+expected["sha256"]
 for name in("candidate-outputs.json","candidate-parts.json"):
  a=assets[name];b=asset(a["id"])
  assert len(b)==a["size"]and "sha256:"+sha(b)==a["digest"]
  keep("release-derived/"+name,b);decoded[name]=json.loads(b)
 out=decoded["candidate-outputs.json"];parts=decoded["candidate-parts.json"]
 assert out["source"]==SOURCE and out["run"]==RUN and out["attempt"]==1 and out["files"]==pub["files"]
 assert out["input"]==dict(bytes=213428829,sha256="72d382ab18e905d13fef8145b70944e681a7a50c16bad0848616652fa93fc0ee")
 assert all(out[k]is False for k in("physical_acceptance","timing_accepted","full_phy_accepted"))
 assert parts["archive"]==pub["archive"]
 assert {p["name"]for p in parts["parts"]}==set(assets)-{"candidate-outputs.json","candidate-parts.json"}
 assert len(parts["parts"])==len({p["name"]for p in parts["parts"]})
 for i,p in enumerate(parts["parts"]):
  assert p["name"]=="candidate-native.tar.gz.part%03d"%i
  a=assets[p["name"]];assert a["size"]==p["bytes"]and a["digest"]=="sha256:"+p["sha256"]
 assert sum(p["bytes"]for p in parts["parts"])==parts["archive"]["bytes"]
 small={}
 for name,pin in pins.items():
  prefix="native-records/native/"
  if name.startswith(prefix):
   member=name[len(prefix):]
   if member in out["files"]:
    assert pin==out["files"][member];small[member]=pin
 return dict(complete_member_map=True,members=len(out["files"]),small_derived_members_joined=len(small),
  complete_archive_parts_API_bound=True,archive=parts["archive"],parts=parts["parts"],
  native_archive_acquired_locally=False,independent_native_archive_reextraction=False)
joined=guarded("capsule-publication-derived-join",capsule_join)
def actual_verdicts():
 host=decoded["result.json"]
 assert host["source"]==SOURCE and host["run_id"]==RUN
 assert all(host[k]is False for k in("physical_acceptance","timing_accepted","full_phy_accepted"))
 result=dict(host_status=host["status"],host_error=host.get("error"),host_terminal_errors=host.get("terminal_errors"),bounded_trial_passed=host.get("bounded_trial_passed"))

  r=decoded.get(name)
  result[name]=r

 return result

receipt=dict(schema="mainchip-multilayer-terminal-derived-receipt-v1",run=RUN,source=SOURCE,attempt=1,
 workflow_conclusion=run["conclusion"],source_controls=source_controls,native_derived_records=native,
 publication_join=joined,actual_verdicts=verdicts,collection_errors=errors,raw_jobs=len(rawlogs),files=pins.copy(),

keep("receipt.json",(json.dumps(receipt,sort_keys=True,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+"\n").encode())
head=api("git/ref/heads/"+B)["object"]["sha"]
tree=api("git/trees/"+head+"?recursive=1");assert not tree.get("truncated")
assert not any(x["path"].startswith(PREFIX)for x in tree["tree"]),"Existing terminal proof: reconcile, never overwrite"

 name,raw=item

with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4)as ex:list(ex.map(verify,files.items()))
print(json.dumps(dict(phase="readback_verified",proof=commit,all_files_verified=True,raw_jobs=len(rawlogs),
